payload.title: Escalation is module-blind: escalation policies and incidents carry no module, policy matching uses severity, rule and farm only, and farm-signal incidents pass no farmId, so a policy authored in the sensor workspace receives farm alarms and its suppression window silences them
evidence: apps/alert-engine/src/escalation/escalation-policy.service.ts:203-227 (findMatchingPolicy filters by severity, ruleId and farmId, then falls back to one tenant-wide default)
apps/alert-engine/src/database/entities/escalation-policy.entity.ts:286-289 (the farm filter is skipped when farmId is absent)
apps/alert-engine/src/alert/services/farm-signal-incident.service.ts:186-187 (farm-signal incidents start escalation with no farmId and no module)
apps/alert-engine/src/escalation/escalation-manager.service.ts:281-287 (a matched policy's suppression window returns null: no escalation)
payload.rule_violated: D4 makes alert module-scoped and D2 keeps module-private data unreachable from another module, so an alarm may escalate only through its own module's policies
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-22, release R7.
